in_sanskrit.name: Krida
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word 'Krida' means 'play' or 'fun'. It is derived from the root 'krid' which means 'to play'. In Hindu mythology, Krida is also the name of the divine play of the gods, which is a metaphor for the cosmic dance of creation and destruction.

in_hindi.name: कृदय
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name 'Kriday' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krida'. It means 'doing something', 'engaging in an activity', or 'playing'. In Hindi, the word 'Kriday' can also be translated as 'fun' or 'enjoyment'.

in_tamil.name: கிர்தய
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name 'Kriday' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krida'. It means 'playground', 'place of play', or 'fun'. In Tamil, the word 'Kriday' can also be used to refer to a fun-filled day or an enjoyable activity.

in_telugu.name: కృదయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name 'Kriday' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krida'. It means 'playful', 'fun-loving', or 'joyful'. In Telugu, the word 'Kriday' can also be used to refer to a joyous occasion or an enjoyable activity.
